definitions.gloss: competitive spirit; fighting spirit; refusal to be beaten
definitions.explanation: The temperament of someone who hates losing and pushes back rather than giving in. Usually admiring, though it can hint at stubbornness.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}けん{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{負|ま}けん{気|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧だった。
examples.english: My younger brother has always been a child who couldn't stand losing.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}けん{気|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to summoning up her competitive spirit and keeping at her training, she was chosen for the national team in the end.

notes:
From ⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to lose) with the old negative ん: literally "the spirit of not losing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負|ま}けん{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have a strong competitive streak (the standard phrase)
- {負|ま}けん{気|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a competitive personality
- {負|ま}けん{気|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to summon up one's fighting spirit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向|む}こう{気|き}→向こう気：30775_mukouki⟧: pluck, combativeness — readiness to take someone on, with less of the hatred of losing
- ⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧: guts, perseverance — about enduring hardship rather than beating a rival
- ⟦{意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}り→意地っ張り：18869_ijippari⟧: stubbornness — the same refusal to yield, but plainly negative
